invariants.rationale: The restore method instantiates and immediately returns a new HoodieRestoreMetadata, so result should never be null.
The restoreInstantTimestamp parameter is likely required for restoration logic and would not be null.
The savepointToRestoreTimestamp parameter is also critical for restore logic and is expected to be non-null.
A non-null HoodieEngineContext is required for restoration actions to be executed.
